newsitem.title: USA: Weaker Hurricane Lili races northeast in Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: Weaker Hurricane Lili races northeast in Atlantic.

text.p: Hurricane Lili lost strength Monday as it raced through the open north Atlantic after a damaging passage through the Caribbean last week, National Hurricane Center said.
At 1100 EDT/1500 GMT, the center of Lili was at latitude 34.2 north, longitude 57.2 west, about 450 miles (725 km) east-northeast of Bermuda, and moving northeast at 18 mph (30 kph).
Maximum sustained winds were 75 mph. The storm was no threat to any land, forecasters said.
Hurricane-force winds extended 85 miles from the center and tropical storm-force winds extended out up to 520 miles.
The storm was expected to slowly weaken Monday and Tuesday.
